adminCategoryDeleteHint: A category with photos can only be removed when you say where its photos go.
adminDeleteCategoryEmpty: The category is empty, its sub categories are deleted too.
adminDeleteCategoryMove: {count} photos are in this category and below. Where should they go?
adminNewEventHint: New conferences start hidden, so they can be prepared before anyone sees them.
adminPhotographersHint: Only people with the photographer role appear here, grant it under
copyrightAccept: By downloading you accept the usage notes.
copyrightNotice: Protected by copyright. Publication only with permission from DMUN e. V. and the credit
dupEditedHint: Probably an edited version, possibly on purpose.
dupIntro: {count} pairs look very much alike. Choose per pair which photo stays in the gallery, the other one is deleted or never published.
dupNone: No open duplicates in this conference.
footerCopyright: All photos are protected by copyright. Publication only with permission from DMUN e. V. and with credit to the photographers.
guestNote: Downloads carry a subtle DMUN watermark.
heroEyebrow: Photo gallery of Deutsche Model United Nations
heroLead: Impressions from MUN-SH in Kiel, MUNBW in Stuttgart and from life in the association, to browse and share. Downloads for the press, schools and participants after approval.
manageCoverHint: Shown large at the top of the conference page and on its tile in the gallery.
manageDragHint: Drag selected photos onto a category to move them. Admins maintain the categories themselves.
manageEditEmpty: Select photos to edit their caption, category, visibility or photographer.
manageGridHint: Click selects, shift-click selects a range, Ctrl/⌘ + A selects all, double-click opens a preview. Drag photos to reorder them, the gallery follows right away.
manageHighlightHint: Highlights appear under "Impressions" on the conference page.
manageIntro: Your conferences and projects. Open one to sort, edit and tidy up its photos.
manageNoEvents: No conference is assigned to you yet. An admin can add you in the conference settings.
manageSetCoverFirst: Set first photo as conference cover
manageTrashNote: Deleted photos stay in the conference's trash for 30 days and can be restored there.
queueEmpty: Nothing to do, every upload is processed.
queueEtaNote: ZIP archives add their photos to the queue once they are unpacked, the estimate grows then.
queueEtaUnknown: Not enough finished tasks yet for an estimate
queueIntro: After an upload the processor renders previews, watermarks and video versions. This page shows what is still waiting and roughly how long it will take.
queueStalledHint: Tasks have been waiting for a while and none is being worked on. The processor may be down, an admin should check its logs.
rightsNote: All photos: © {holder}, use only with permission and attribution.
settingsCredit: Show the photo credit under the logo
settingsDownloadsHint: Always: everyone gets the watermark. For guests: team members get the clean file. Optional: watermarked by default, team members may opt out.
settingsNoSample: Upload a photo to see a preview.
settingsRerenderText: The watermark and the download sizes are baked into every rendered file. Saving these changes renders all {count} photos again in the background. That can take hours, and new uploads wait in the same queue until it is done.
settingsSavedRerender: Saved, {count} photos are being rendered again
settingsWatermarkHint: The white DMUN logo is used. Existing photos are rendered again in the background after saving.
tagline: The photo gallery of Model United Nations conferences by DMUN e. V.
trashConfirmText: The originals and every size are removed from the storage. This cannot be undone.
trashIntro: Deleted photos stay here for 30 days. Restore them or delete them for good.
uploadAccepted: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 50 MB per file · the capture date is taken from the photo
uploadBackground: You can leave this window open and keep working, the upload continues in the background.
uploadHeldNote: Held duplicates only appear in the gallery after your decision.
uploadIntro: Uploaded photos appear in the gallery right away, so set the target and visibility before uploading.
usageAttribution: Every publication names the photographer and DMUN e. V., for example „Photo: M. Sayk / DMUN e. V.“. The credit sits next to the photo or in the imprint of the publication.
usageCopyright: All photos in this gallery are protected by copyright. DMUN e. V. holds the rights of use. Browsing and sharing links is free, publishing a photo requires permission.
usageEditHint: Shown on the usage notes page and in the lightbox. An empty line separates paragraphs. When a language is empty, the German text is shown.
usageIntro: How you may use the photos from our conferences and projects.
usagePermission: Press, schools and participants receive permission for their own reporting on request. Please write to DMUN e. V. and name the photos and the intended use.
usageWatermark: Downloads carry a subtle DMUN watermark.
usersAdminText: Everything, plus conferences, people and settings
usersFootnote: Role changes apply immediately. Admins and team members come from the configuration. Photographers get their conferences in the conference settings.
usersInviteText: The person becomes a photographer as soon as they sign in with this email. No email is sent, share the gallery link yourself.
usersPhotographerText: Additionally upload and manage the assigned conferences
zipAccepted: Up to 20 GB · folders become categories · JPG, PNG and WebP inside
zipIntro: The folder structure of the archive becomes categories: top folders become categories, folders inside them sub categories. Check the mapping before uploading.
zipQueued: Archive uploaded, the photos are being imported.
zipRules: Gallery categories reach three levels, deeper folders are merged into the third. System files (__MACOSX, .DS_Store) and anything that is not a photo are ignored. Similar names are matched to existing categories, the selection changes that.
zipServerNote: The archive is unpacked on the server, you can close the window afterwards. Possible duplicates are held like in the single file upload.
zipSkipRoot: Skip the top folder „{folder}“, it only carries the conference name
zipToggleSubfolders: Show or hide the subfolders of {folder}
